convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'KalmanFilter' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing and order execution logic. Custom indicator signals cannot be replicated without porting the indicator itself.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before processing

other_exits: Buy close triggered when KalmanFilter signal flips to 0 (sell signal)
Sell close triggered when KalmanFilter signal flips to 1 (buy signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1), BALANCE/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance, FREEMARGIN/LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin. Negative MM values may be treated as fixed lots, positive as fraction - exact logic in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic uses KalmanFilter buffer index 1 (trend direction: 1=up, 0=down) and buffer index 0 (previous direction) for transition detection. BUY_Open requires Col[1]==1 AND Col[0]==0 (transition from down to up). SELL_Open requires Col[1]==0 AND Col[0]==1 (transition from up to down). When SignalBar==0, signals are checked every tick without new bar guard. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable long entry, short entry, short close, and long close respectively. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests the TradeAlgorithms library uses global variables for state tracking.
python_conversion_notes: Must port KalmanFilter custom indicator logic to Python first - the EA is meaningless without it. The indicator uses a Kalman filter with tuning parameter Kf and applied price IPC. Entry signals are zero-crossing transitions on buffer 1 (1→0 for short, 0→1 for long) with confirmation from buffer 0 showing prior state. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers that handle margin calculation, position checking, and order placement - these must be reimplemented. The MarginMode enum supports 5 sizing modes. The LoadHistory() call ensures bar data is available. Signal timestamps are computed as bar open time + bar duration for position open functions.
